title: In Vitro Synthesized mRNA Transfection to Perkinsus marinus
author: Yoshihisa Hirakawa
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vcme2u6
materials: mRNA with a 5′ m 7 G cap and 3′ poly(A)-tail was synthesized by mMESSAGE mMACHINE T7 Transcription Kit (Ambion) with the linearized plasmid of T7-SL-eGFP (it was digested by Pvu II). The synthesized mRNA was treated by TURBO DNase, and collected by ethanol precipitation according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The mRNA concentration was calculated by Qubit 3.0 (Thermo Life Technologies).

steps.title: Construct T7‑SL‑eGFP plasmid
steps.instruction: Insert the egfp gene flanked by the P. marinus TPT2 5′ UTR (including the spliced‑leader sequence ACCGTAGCCATCTTGGCTCAAG) and the P. marinus MOE 3′ UTR into the pSP72 vector (Promega) to create the plasmid T7‑SL‑eGFP; the construct is available as T7‑SL‑eGFP.pdf.

steps.title: Prepare P. marinus cells
steps.instruction: Collect 5 × 10⁷ log‑phase P. marinus trophozoites, centrifuge at 3 000 g for 5 min, and resuspend the pellet in 100 µL solution 2 from the Basic Parasite Nucleofector Kit 2 (Lonza).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge 5 × 10⁷ trophozoites at 3 000 g for 5 min.
Resuspend pellet in 100 µL solution 2 (Lonza Basic Parasite Nucleofector Kit 2).

steps.title: Electroporate cells with mRNA
steps.instruction: Add synthesized mRNA to the cell suspension at the chosen amount (1, 5, 10, or 20 µg), electroporate using the Amaxa Nucleofector II (Lonza) with program D‑023, then transfer the cells to 2 mL fresh ATCC medium 1886 in a 6‑well plate.

substeps.instruction: Add synthesized mRNA (1, 5, 10, or 20 µg) to the 100 µL cell suspension.
Electroporate with Amaxa Nucleofector II using program D‑023.
Transfer electroporated cells to 2 mL fresh ATCC medium 1886 in a 6‑well plate.

steps.title: Observe GFP expression
steps.instruction: Incubate the transfected cells for 24–48 h, then examine them under an inverted fluorescence microscope equipped with a GFP filter.

substeps.instruction: Examine cells under an inverted fluorescence microscope with a GFP filter.
